LanguageData.useVersionCompareDescription: Enable Version checking between saved file and current version. check steam workshop for the detailed description.
LanguageData.EnableWritingCustomVersionHeader: Enable writing mod metadata to the save
LanguageData.writeMetaDescription: Enable writing mod metadata to the save (mod versions, etc). enable recommended
LanguageData.ModMismatchFormatter_State_Added: Not in the save; added since.
LanguageData.ModMismatchFormatter_State_Removed: In the save, but not running now.
LanguageData.ModMismatchFormatter_State_MovedFrom: Position in the save. This mod still runs, but at a different place in the load order now.
LanguageData.ModMismatchFormatter_State_MovedTo: Current position. This mod was at a different place in the save's load order.
LanguageData.ModMismatchFormatter_State_VersionChange: The version differs from the one recorded in the save.
